question: Does a higher-precision fresh-seed holdout confirm that the frozen Trust Governor and Capacity Operator remain inside every supported player-count balance bound while retaining their claimed behavior?

selectionRule.balance: Select only if every three-, four-, and five-player faction, seat, profile, diversity, fallback, and forced-no-op bound passes with no credible homogeneous or pairwise dominance.
selectionRule.trustIdentity: Trust Governor must average at least one Influence selection per appearance, keep Influence below its largest Core Action, reach Trust 4 in at least 85 percent of appearances, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.capacityIdentity: Capacity Operator must average at least two Build selections per appearance, select Research plus Deploy more often than Build, and retain mean Mandate of at least 16.
selectionRule.failure: If any supported player-count balance bound fails again, reject canonical profile promotion and investigate the named strategy or Action through a separate preregistered intervention. Do not alter faction starts from a profile-only failure.
selectionRule.agiBoundary: AGI emergence is diagnostic only in this study. Dossier costs require a separate one-lever physical-rules study.

requiredDiagnostics: profile Action selections and Mandate sources
profile and faction win shares by supported player count
AGI emergence and winner override rates
